The Bairaha Group
Bairaha Farms PLC is the parent company of a vertically integrated poultry and food business, with core activities
spanning from poultry farming, chicken processing to manufacture of pre-cooked meat products. Its subsidiaries,
sub-subsidiaries and joint ventures support key stages of the value chain, including broiler grandparent, and parent
breeding, hatchery operations, broiler farming, feed milling, further processing, land development and nutraceutical
products manufacturing.
